evaluation.error: Keep the public module parameters and ports unchanged; whitespace may vary
evaluation.limitation: Synthetic faults; six finite directed/random regressions and 16/12-step two-state checks at fixed profiles. Not real-world defect discovery, all-parameter correctness or an unbounded proof. No clean RTL is read by this evaluator.

proposal.explanation: The ready signal condition used `count <= DEPTH` which is always true, causing s_ready to remain high even when the buffer is full and no dequeue occurs. This violates the contract requirement that s_ready be high only when there is unused capacity or a simultaneous dequeue. Fixed by changing to `count < DEPTH`. Also corrected Verilog 2001 syntax: removed `parameter` keyword from module parameter list.
